findings.note: Judge first (941ee92): a 'recording, Voice card closed' state that requires a visible, uncovered Stop; on the pre-fix build both landscape sizes fail. Fix (09a58e9): the transport steps aside only while the Voice card is open (data-take-card), so closing the card mid-take brings its Stop back under the photo. Escape does not close the card mid-take in this layout (probed: focus stays on the card's Stop); its Close key does, and that is the judged path.

09a58e9: the focus hand-off follows stopAside (the phone take sheet or the docked landscape card), so a keyboard REC at 844x390 lands on the card's Stop (probed); focus left on a control the layout hid counts as lost and moves to the transport's Stop.
941ee92: the Filmstrip's sticky handle is excused only while the strip can scroll the way that clears it (scrollLeft > 0 for a handle on the left, room to scroll for one on the right).
